title: Add ping() to orgos/agile/ping.py
body: Create `/root/orgos/agile/ping.py` with a single function `ping()` that returns the string `'pong'`. The file must be importable as `from orgos.agile.ping import ping`. No other dependencies. Target file is NEW.

votes.justification: This is a trivial task requiring a single-function file with no dependencies, no design decisions, and no integration risk. The implementation takes under 30 minutes including testing and commit.

This is a trivial single-function file with no dependencies, so testing is straightforward — a simple import and assertion verifies it. No risk of hidden complexity or integration issues from my perspective.
A single function returning a string has no dependencies and trivial surface area — no secrets or security risk to review. Effort is well under 30 minutes.

comments.author: test_reviewer
comments.body: Review PASS: ping() implementation meets all AC: function returns 'pong', importable from orgos.agile.ping, no extra dependencies, tests pass.
